title: Kenen: asking about one owner
summary: Ask about one owner with kenen: Kenen kirja tämä on? (“Whose book is this?”).
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Ask about one owner with kenen: Kenen kirja tämä on? (“Whose book is this?”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The question word refers to the owner, not the number of objects. These questions all concern one object, shown by tämä on.
Kuka (“who”) becomes kenen (“whose”, one owner). Kenen kirja tämä on? asks who owns this book.
A name or noun can answer: Annan (“Anna's”), lapsen (“the child's”). These answer forms are shown for understanding; the questions practise forming kenen phrases.
keyPoints: Choose the question word from the owners' number.
